sentences.en: The first meridian circle of China has been installed at CSAO in April 1990. This horizontal reflecting transit circle with 240ram effective aperture is developed by CSAO, NAIF and CUO.

sentences.en: I have to say, perhaps the most innovative response was from Dr. Naif al-Mutawa of Kuwait, who joins us here tonight.

sentences.en: Accused of being a revolutionary, or at best a naif , Bernstein never recovered from the damage this did to his reputation.
